## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive. XLK in RECOVERY (1W: +0.57% | 1M: -4.76%) and XLF in RECOVERY (1W: +0.64% | 1M: -0.72%); VXX in CORRECTION (1W: -4.35% | 1M: +2.90%) ↓ falling, signaling lower near-term fear but mixed 1M signals.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Credit mixed: HYG in CORRECTION (1W: -0.11% | 1M: +0.10%) vs LQD ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.04% | 1M: +1.19%) → neutral HYG/LQD. Stocks vs bonds neutral as SPY in RECOVERY (1W: +0.70% | 1M: -0.89%) vs TLT ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.73% | 1M: +3.21%).

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Dollar neutral: UUP (1W: +0.00% | 1M: +0.00%) NEUTRAL; yields showing mild easing via TLT ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.73% | 1M: +3.21%) ↑ rising, keeping conditions steady.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Defensive leadership: XLU ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.32% | 1M: +8.63%) and XLP ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.36% | 1M: +6.85%); Energy XLE in CORRECTION (1W: -0.24% | 1M: +10.83%) showing 1W softness. Style mixed / no clear leadership given XLK and XLF both in RECOVERY.

**5. US vs Global?**
US RECOVERY: SPY in RECOVERY (1W: +0.70% | 1M: -0.89%) while EM/Emerging strength persists with EEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.74% | 1M: +3.93%) and Japan EWJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.40% | 1M: +7.74%); China FXI BELOW TREND (1W: -3.16% | 1M: -6.38%) showing continued weakness.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Small caps upbeat: IWM ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.53% | 1M: +0.48%). Disruption/crypto mixed: ARKK in RECOVERY (1W: +3.28% | 1M: -6.47%) and IBIT in RECOVERY (1W: +0.50% | 1M: -24.43%) — speculative flows present but uneven.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Industrial/metal support: CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.35% | 1M: +0.41%) ↑ rising; Gold GLD ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.90% | 1M: +0.29%) ↑ rising while Silver SLV in RECOVERY (1W: +13.29% | 1M: -20.81%) remains volatile.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy mixed: XLE in CORRECTION (1W: -0.24% | 1M: +10.83%) and BNO in CORRECTION (1W: -0.59% | 1M: +7.61%) showing 1W pullbacks off strong 1M gains; natural gas UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -3.56% | 1M: -22.59%) ↓ falling.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
Confirmed: Broad participation with 10/11 sectors positive validates market breadth. MAJOR Divergence: SPY, XLK, XLF all show 1W positive / 1M negative (RECOVERY) — suppresses strong directional regime calls and signals a transitional market.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor defensive exposure in the near term given utilities/staples strength (XLU ABOVE TREND, XLP ABOVE TREND) and maintain selective cyclicals (XLB, XLI). Monitor tech (XLK RECOVERY) and China (FXI BELOW TREND) closely and reduce exposure to clear China weakness.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: Utilities XLU ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.32% | 1M: +8.63%) and Materials XLB ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.32% | 1M: +6.04%) if momentum holds. BEARISH: China FXI BELOW TREND (1W: -3.16% | 1M: -6.38%) and Natural Gas UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -3.56% | 1M: -22.59%).

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: Copper CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.35% | 1M: +0.41%) and Gold GLD ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.90% | 1M: +0.29%). BEARISH: Natural gas UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -3.56% | 1M: -22.59%) and inflation-sensitive silver SLV in RECOVERY (1W: +13.29% | 1M: -20.81%) — watch volatility.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX ~20 (volatility complacency pivot); HYG/LQD ~0.80 (credit stress pivot); XLK/XLF ~2.0 (growth vs value leadership pivot).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive, broad participation despite mixed timeframe signals. Utilities and Staples showing strength; MAJOR divergence in core risk ETFs (SPY/XLK/XLF 1W vs 1M) is the key risk to monitor.
